rationale: Pivot from xgb_regime_blend (8 train iter, best 2/7 wp, recent runs flat/negative ann). anomaly_gated_histgb has best wp=5 of any family in last 200 iter (n=46 train) and is the only registered trainer with date-level density-based abstention (Isolation Forest day-mean) — the mechanism Part A failure_pattern points to (W4 hostile / W5 deep bear, both fail 55-90% across trainer families regardless of architecture). 16 HPs in the search space (gate_threshold, gating_alpha, day_abstain_q, anomaly_as_feature × HistGB quadrant + IF knobs) are wide-open for train mode to sweep; prior best at iter #1675 (4/7) was BEFORE the 2026-05-26 regime-aware MIN_WR gate change, so a fresh sweep against the harder bar is warranted.
